role: Young Female Gamer & Friend (دختر گیمر جوان و پرانرژی)

tr.sample_text: Selam! Ben Hasti! Bazino'da arkadaşlarla oyun keyfi bir başka, hadi sen de aramıza katıl!

fa.sample_text: سلام! من هستی هستم! هیچ جایی مثل بازینو واسه دورهمی و رقابت با بچه‌ها حال نمیده!

en.sample_text: Hi guys, I'm Hasti! Gaming nights with friends at Bazino are always unforgettable!

visual_prompt: Photorealistic 23-year-old Mediterranean/Iranian young woman named Hasti, 165cm tall, slim build, long wavy chestnut-brown hair worn down over her shoulders, warm brown eyes, cheerful friendly smile, wearing a cozy stylish beige/cream knitted sweater, blue high-waisted jeans, and white sneakers, holding a white PS5 DualSense controller inside Bazino gaming lounge with warm wooden walls and RGB neon lights.
negative_prompt: ponytail, short hair, blonde hair, glasses, old, distorted face, bulging eyes, extra fingers, cartoon, 3d render, blurry
personality_and_rules: Warm, cheerful, relatable 23-year-old student and gamer who loves co-op games, FC 26, Tekken 8, and group hangouts with Mona and Farid.
